description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District  - Cad. Map No. 520006
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about land parcels, including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and amendments to ownership details and identity card numbers. The content is entirely focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
